championship_riders_order_check.name: championship_riders_order_check
championship_riders_order_check.value:
("championship_riders"."roster_slot" = 'ACTIVE' and "championship_riders"."initial_order" between 1 and 4)
          or ("championship_riders"."roster_slot" = 'RESERVE' and "championship_riders"."initial_order" is null)

tie_break_entries_subject_check.name: tie_break_entries_subject_check
tie_break_entries_subject_check.value: ("tie_break_entries"."championship_rider_id" is not null) <> ("tie_break_entries"."championship_country_id" is not null)
